title: Clock systems for stochastic and non-deterministic categorical systems theories
summary: One of the characteristic features of categorical systems theory is that the behavior of systems can be characterized by certain morphisms into them. In other words, behaviors form a representable covariant functor to Set. And more generally, in the compositional setting, behaviors form a representable double functor to Span. Clock systems are convenient because behavior functors represented by clock systems are automatically well-behaved.
